metadata.system_summary: STEM research club attendance management system (kintai-v3). Next.js + Supabase + Discord OAuth. Features: NFC card-based kiosk attendance tracking, QR code user registration, OAuth 2.0 authorization server, admin dashboard. Three database schemas: member (user/team data), attendance (card IDs, attendance logs, temp registrations), oauth (client apps, authorization codes with PKCE, user consents). Security: RLS on all tables, SECURITY DEFINER RPC for kiosk, kiosk token-based middleware, least-privilege anon access.
